name: Day 21 — 公司健檢 The Health Check

readings.title: 不能吃早餐 No Breakfast Allowed

qs.q: Why can't the narrator eat breakfast?
ch: Today is the company health check

qs.q: What is the wife eating?
What does she promise after the check?
ch: To treat him to two servings

gram.t: Body part + 痛/餓/痛苦 — saying what hurts
gram.d: State the part, then the feeling: 頭痛 headache, 肚子餓 stomach's hungry, 喉嚨痛 sore throat. No 'my is' needed — 我肚子好餓 is complete. The clinic's first question is 哪裡不舒服？ where's the discomfort? Now you can answer.

qs.q: What is measured first?
How is his blood pressure?
What does the nurse joke about?
ch: Whether all engineers have such good eyes

gram.t: 先…然後…最後 — the full sequence chain
gram.d: Extend 先…再… into a three-step itinerary: 先量身高，然後量血壓，最後檢查視力。 First height, then blood pressure, finally vision. Any process — recipes, meetings, checkups — snaps into this frame.

qs.q: How does the narrator feel about the blood draw?
What does the nurse tell him to do?
Why can they eat cookies afterward?
ch: Because they fasted before the draw

gram.t: verb + 一下 — the gentle softener
gram.d: 一下 makes any verb small and easy: 放鬆一下 relax a sec, 等一下 hold on, 看一下 take a quick look, 量一下 let me just measure. Requests soften, commands turn friendly — medical staff and shopkeepers run on 一下.

readings.title: 成語故事：諱疾忌醫 Chengyu: Hiding the Illness, Dodging the Doctor

qs.q: What did Bian Que tell the king?
ch: He was ill, and treating it now would be easy

qs.q: What happened as the king kept refusing?
ch: The illness went deeper and deeper until it was too late

qs.q: What does 諱疾忌醫 describe?
ch: Having a problem but refusing to face it

gram.d: 越來越 + adjective/verb tracks a rising curve: 病越來越深 the illness deepens, 天氣越來越熱 hotter and hotter, 中文越來越好 your Mandarin keeps improving. Variant 越 A 越 B: 越想越氣 the more I think, the angrier I get.

qs.q: Who pays for the health check?
How often do colleagues aged thirty and above get checks?
What was the hospitalization subsidy raised to?

gram.d: Number + 以上 = and above; + 以下 = and below: 三十歲以上 thirty and older, 三十杯以上打八折 thirty-plus cups get the discount, 體脂三十以下 body fat under thirty. Policies, promos, and health reports all draw their lines with this pair.

qs.q: Why is drone delivery valuable for Taiwan's offshore islands?
ch: Transport is inconvenient and weather often disrupted medicine and blood deliveries

qs.q: How fast did trial deliveries arrive?
What do experts predict for remote areas?
ch: Medical quality no longer limited by distance

gram.t: 透過 — through, by means of
gram.d: 透過 + channel + result: 透過無人機配送，藥品三十分鐘送達。 Via drone delivery, medicine arrives in thirty minutes. 透過朋友介紹 through a friend's introduction. The formal 'via' — reports and news reach every outcome 透過 something.

dict.py: Jīntiān zǎoshàng bùnéng chī dōngxi.
dict.en: No eating this morning.

dict.py: Wǒ de dùzi hǎo è!
dict.en: My stomach is so hungry!

dict.py: Wǒ de ěrduo yǒu yìdiǎn tòng.
dict.en: My ear hurts a little.

dict.zh: 鼻子不舒服，可能感冒了。
dict.py: Bízi bù shūfú, kěnéng gǎnmào le.
dict.en: My nose feels off — maybe a cold.

dict.zh: 脖子痛的話，不要一直看手機。
dict.py: Bózi tòng dehuà, búyào yìzhí kàn shǒujī.
dict.en: If your neck hurts, stop staring at your phone.

pass.zh: 老公，檢查加油喔！我知道你餓，檢查完打給我，我帶你去吃蛋餅，兩份！還有豆漿！你最勇敢了！

qs.q: What should he do after the check?
What will she treat him to?
ch: Two egg crepes and soy milk

dict.py: Qǐng xiān liáng shēngāo gēn tǐzhòng.
dict.en: Please measure height and weight first.

dict.zh: 一百七十八公分，七十二公斤。
dict.py: Yìbǎi qīshíbā gōngfēn, qīshí'èr gōngjīn.
dict.en: One seventy-eight centimeters, seventy-two kilograms.

dict.py: Xiànzài bāng nín liáng xiěyā.
dict.en: Now I'll take your blood pressure.

dict.py: Shùzì hěn biāozhǔn, búyòng dānxīn.
dict.en: The numbers are normal — no need to worry.

dict.py: Hùlǐshī rén hěn wēnróu.
dict.en: The nurse is very gentle.

pass.zh: 下一位！先生您好，先脫鞋子站上來，量身高體重。好，接下來坐這裡，手放輕鬆，量血壓。血壓很標準！最後去三號窗口檢查視力，謝謝！

qs.q: What must he do before stepping on the scale?
Where does he go last?
ch: Window three for the vision test

dict.py: Xià yí zhàn shì chōuxiě.
dict.en: Next station: the blood draw.

dict.py: Fàngsōng yíxià, wòquán.
dict.en: Relax a bit — make a fist.

dict.py: Hěn kuài jiù hǎo, bú huì tòng.
dict.en: Quick and painless.

dict.zh: 因為空腹，等一下可以吃餅乾。
dict.py: Yīnwèi kōngfù, děng yíxià kěyǐ chī bǐnggān.
dict.en: Since you fasted, you can have cookies after.

dict.py: Yì rén yì bāo ō!
dict.en: One pack per person!

pass.zh: 先生，抽血前確認一下：今天空腹八小時了嗎？有沒有吃藥？好，那我們開始。看旁邊，深呼吸——好了！壓著棉花五分鐘，不要揉喔。旁邊有餅乾跟豆漿，請慢用！

qs.q: What does the nurse confirm before drawing blood?
ch: Eight hours of fasting and any medications

qs.q: What should he do with the cotton pad?
ch: Press for five minutes without rubbing

dict.zh: 報告的數值大部分都正常。
dict.py: Bàogào de shùzhí dàbùfèn dōu zhèngcháng.
dict.en: Most of the report's numbers are normal.

dict.zh: 這一項要三個月後復診。
dict.py: Zhè yí xiàng yào sān ge yuè hòu fùzhěn.
dict.en: This item needs a follow-up visit in three months.

dict.py: Wǒmen xiān zhuīzōng, búyòng chī yào.
dict.en: We'll monitor it first — no medication needed.

dict.zh: 國王諱疾忌醫，最後太晚了。
dict.py: Guówáng huì jí jì yī, zuìhòu tài wǎn le.
dict.en: The king hid his illness and dodged doctors — until too late.

dict.py: Yǒu wèntí jiù yào miànduì.
dict.en: If there's a problem, face it.

pass.zh: 醫生說：「整體很不錯！只有一個數值高了一點，跟你的睡眠有關係。不用緊張，先調整作息，三個月後復診追蹤。記得：不要當諱疾忌醫的國王喔！」

qs.q: What is the slightly high number related to?
What is the doctor's plan?
ch: Adjust routine, follow up in three months

dict.zh: 健檢的費用由公司負擔。
dict.py: Jiànjiǎn de fèiyòng yóu gōngsī fùdān.
dict.en: The health-check cost is borne by the company.

dict.py: Sānshí suì yǐshàng, měi nián yí cì.
dict.en: Thirty and above: once a year.

dict.py: Tuántǐ bǎoxiǎn shēngjí le.
dict.en: The group insurance was upgraded.

dict.zh: 住院補助提高到每天兩千元。
dict.py: Zhùyuàn bǔzhù tígāo dào měi tiān liǎngqiān yuán.
dict.en: The hospitalization subsidy rose to two thousand a day.

dict.py: Shēntǐ shì běnqián, yào zhàogù hǎo.
dict.en: Health is your capital — take care of it.

pass.zh: 人事公告：今年的健檢報告兩週後寄到公司，由小美統一發給大家。另外提醒：保險升級之後，看牙齒也有補助了，一年最多三千元，收據記得留下來，找小美申請。

qs.q: How will the reports be distributed?
ch: Xiaomei hands them out at the company

qs.q: What new subsidy comes with the insurance upgrade?
ch: Dental care, up to three thousand a year with receipts

dict.zh: 無人機正快速進入醫療領域。
dict.py: Wúrénjī zhèng kuàisù jìnrù yīliáo lǐngyù.
dict.en: Drones are rapidly entering the medical field.

dict.zh: 離島的交通常受天氣影響。
dict.py: Lídǎo de jiāotōng cháng shòu tiānqì yǐngxiǎng.
dict.en: Offshore-island transport is often weather-affected.

dict.zh: 透過無人機配送，三十分鐘內送達。
dict.py: Tòuguò wúrénjī pèisòng, sānshí fēnzhōng nèi sòngdá.
dict.en: Via drone delivery, arrival within thirty minutes.

dict.zh: 預防醫學越來越受重視。
dict.py: Yùfáng yīxué yuè lái yuè shòu zhòngshì.
dict.en: Preventive medicine is taken ever more seriously.

dict.zh: 醫療品質將不再受距離限制。
dict.py: Yīliáo pǐnzhí jiāng bú zài shòu jùlí xiànzhì.
dict.en: Medical quality will no longer be limited by distance.

pass.zh: 科技新聞：離島醫療配送試驗傳出好成績——無人機把急用的藥品跟血品，平均二十八分鐘送達，成功率百分之九十八。衛生單位表示，明年將擴大到山區部落。業界認為，醫療配送將成為無人機商用市場成長最快的一塊。

qs.q: What were the trial's average delivery time and success rate?
What expansion is planned next year?

scenarios.intro: Fasting since midnight. She's eating breakfast. This is a test of love and hunger.

them.zh: 早安！你今天不能吃早餐喔！
them.py: Zǎo'ān! Nǐ jīntiān bùnéng chī zǎocān ō!
them.en: Morning! No breakfast for you today!

turns.task: You know — your stomach is SO hungry.

ans.zh: 我知道……我的肚子好餓！
ans.py: Wǒ zhīdào…… wǒ de dùzi hǎo è!
ans.en: I know… my stomach is SO hungry!

them.zh: 忍耐一下！水可以喝一點點。
them.py: Rěnnài yíxià! Shuǐ kěyǐ hē yìdiǎndiǎn.
them.en: Hang in there! You can have a tiny bit of water.

turns.task: Complain sweetly — her egg crepe smells amazing and your nose is suffering.

ans.zh: 你的蛋餅好香，我的鼻子好痛苦！
ans.py: Nǐ de dànbǐng hǎo xiāng, wǒ de bízi hǎo tòngkǔ!
ans.en: Your egg crepe smells amazing — my nose is in agony!

them.zh: 哈哈對不起啦！檢查完請你吃兩份！
them.py: Hāhā duìbùqǐ la! Jiǎnchá wán qǐng nǐ chī liǎng fèn!
them.en: Haha sorry! Two servings on me after the check!

turns.task: Deal! You'll call her the moment it's done.

ans.zh: 一言為定！檢查完我馬上打給你！
ans.py: Yì yán wéi dìng! Jiǎnchá wán wǒ mǎshàng dǎ gěi nǐ!
ans.en: Deal! I'll call you the second it's done!

them.zh: 抽血的時候不要怕喔！
them.py: Chōuxiě de shíhòu búyào pà ō!
them.en: Don't be scared during the blood draw!

turns.task: You're brave! …mostly. You'll look the other way.

ans.zh: 我很勇敢！……我會看別的地方啦。
ans.py: Wǒ hěn yǒnggǎn! ……wǒ huì kàn bié de dìfāng la.
ans.en: I'm brave! …I'll just look the other way.

them.zh: 哈哈加油！我等你的電話！
them.py: Hāhā jiāyóu! Wǒ děng nǐ de diànhuà!
them.en: Haha, you got this! I'll wait for your call!

turns.task: Head out — see her at the breakfast shop at noon!

ans.zh: 我出門了！中午早餐店見！
ans.py: Wǒ chūmén le! Zhōngwǔ zǎocāndiàn jiàn!
ans.en: I'm off! See you at the breakfast shop at noon!

scenarios.intro: Scale, cuff, eye chart. Follow instructions, collect compliments on your blood pressure.

them.zh: 下一位！先生早安，先量身高體重，請脫鞋站上來。
them.py: Xià yí wèi! Xiānshēng zǎo'ān, xiān liáng shēngāo tǐzhòng, qǐng tuō xié zhàn shànglái.
them.en: Next! Morning, sir — height and weight first. Shoes off, step up.

turns.task: Good morning — comply and ask if you should stand straight.

ans.zh: 早安！好的。要站直嗎？
ans.py: Zǎo'ān! Hǎo de. Yào zhàn zhí ma?
ans.en: Morning! Sure — should I stand up straight?

them.zh: 對，眼睛看前面。一百七十八，七十二公斤，很好！
them.py: Duì, yǎnjīng kàn qiánmiàn. Yìbǎi qīshíbā, qīshí'èr gōngjīn, hěn hǎo!
them.en: Yes, eyes forward. One seventy-eight, seventy-two kilos — great!

turns.task: Ask what's next.

ans.zh: 謝謝！接下來是什麼？
ans.py: Xièxiè! Jiē xiàlái shì shénme?
ans.en: Thanks! What's next?

them.zh: 量血壓。坐這裡，手放桌上，放輕鬆。
them.py: Liáng xiěyā. Zuò zhèlǐ, shǒu fàng zhuō shàng, fàng qīngsōng.
them.en: Blood pressure. Sit here, arm on the table, relax.

turns.task: Mention you drank coffee yesterday — does that affect blood pressure?

ans.zh: 好。請問我昨天喝了咖啡，會影響血壓嗎？
ans.py: Hǎo. Qǐngwèn wǒ zuótiān hē le kāfēi, huì yǐngxiǎng xiěyā ma?
ans.en: OK — quick question, I had coffee yesterday. Does that affect blood pressure?

them.zh: 昨天的沒關係，今天早上沒喝就好。嗯——血壓很標準！
them.py: Zuótiān de méi guānxì, jīntiān zǎoshàng méi hē jiù hǎo. Ēn — xiěyā hěn biāozhǔn!
them.en: Yesterday's fine, as long as none this morning. And — very normal!

turns.task: Great news — where's the vision test?

ans.zh: 太好了！請問視力檢查在哪裡？
ans.py: Tài hǎo le! Qǐngwèn shìlì jiǎnchá zài nǎlǐ?
ans.en: Excellent! Where's the vision test?

them.zh: 三號窗口，直走右轉。加油，快結束了！
them.py: Sān hào chuāngkǒu, zhí zǒu yòu zhuǎn. Jiāyóu, kuài jiéshù le!
them.en: Window three — straight, then right. Almost done!

turns.task: Thank her — she's the gentlest nurse ever.

ans.zh: 謝謝你，你是我遇過最溫柔的護理師！
ans.py: Xièxiè nǐ, nǐ shì wǒ yù guò zuì wēnróu de hùlǐshī!
ans.en: Thank you — gentlest nurse I've ever met!

scenarios.intro: The station everyone whispers about. Fist clenched, eyes elsewhere, dignity intact.

them.zh: 先生請坐！今天空腹八小時了嗎？
them.py: Xiānshēng qǐng zuò! Jīntiān kōngfù bā xiǎoshí le ma?
them.en: Have a seat! Fasted eight hours today?

turns.task: Yes — nothing since last night, only a little water.

ans.zh: 有，昨天晚上到現在都空腹，只喝了一點水。
ans.py: Yǒu, zuótiān wǎnshàng dào xiànzài dōu kōngfù, zhǐ hē le yìdiǎn shuǐ.
ans.en: Yes — fasting since last night, just a little water.

them.zh: 很好！手伸出來，握拳。會有一點點感覺喔。
them.py: Hěn hǎo! Shǒu shēn chūlái, wòquán. Huì yǒu yìdiǎndiǎn gǎnjué ō.
them.en: Perfect! Arm out, make a fist. You'll feel a tiny pinch.

turns.task: Admit you're a little scared — you'll look the other way.

ans.zh: 我有一點怕，我看別的地方好了！
ans.py: Wǒ yǒu yìdiǎn pà, wǒ kàn bié de dìfāng hǎo le!
ans.en: I'm a bit scared — I'll just look over there!

them.zh: 沒問題！深呼吸——好了！你看，不痛吧？
them.py: Méi wèntí! Shēn hūxī — hǎo le! Nǐ kàn, bú tòng ba?
them.en: No problem! Deep breath — done! See? Painless.

turns.task: Really painless! Ask how long to press the cotton.

ans.zh: 真的不痛！請問棉花要壓多久？
ans.py: Zhēn de bú tòng! Qǐngwèn miánhuā yào yā duōjiǔ?
ans.en: Truly painless! How long do I press the cotton?

them.zh: 五分鐘，不要揉。旁邊有餅乾跟豆漿，請慢用！
them.py: Wǔ fēnzhōng, búyào róu. Pángbiān yǒu bǐnggān gēn dòujiāng, qǐng màn yòng!
them.en: Five minutes, no rubbing. Cookies and soy milk are over there — enjoy!

turns.task: Ask if you can take one for your coworker who's still in line.

ans.zh: 謝謝！可以幫還在排隊的同事拿一包嗎？
ans.py: Xièxiè! Kěyǐ bāng hái zài páiduì de tóngshì ná yì bāo ma?
ans.en: Thanks! May I grab a pack for my coworker still in line?

them.zh: 哈哈可以，你人真好！一人一包喔！
them.py: Hāhā kěyǐ, nǐ rén zhēn hǎo! Yì rén yì bāo ō!
them.en: Haha sure, how kind! One pack per person!

turns.task: Promise — one each, and thank her for the smooth work.

ans.zh: 一人一包，我保證！謝謝你，抽得又快又好！
ans.py: Yì rén yì bāo, wǒ bǎozhèng! Xièxiè nǐ, chōu de yòu kuài yòu hǎo!
ans.en: One each, promise! And thanks — that was quick and flawless!

scenarios.intro: Two weeks later, the results are in. Mostly green, one red number, and a doctor with a chengyu ready.

them.zh: 請坐！整體很不錯，大部分的數值都正常。
them.py: Qǐng zuò! Zhěngtǐ hěn búcuò, dàbùfèn de shùzhí dōu zhèngcháng.
them.en: Have a seat! Overall quite good — most numbers are normal.

turns.task: Relieved — but ask about the one red number you saw.

ans.zh: 太好了！可是我看到有一個紅字，那是什麼？
ans.py: Tài hǎo le! Kěshì wǒ kàndào yǒu yí ge hóngzì, nà shì shénme?
ans.en: Great! But I saw one number in red — what's that?

them.zh: 那個跟睡眠有關，高了一點點。你最近常熬夜嗎？
them.py: Nàge gēn shuìmián yǒuguān, gāo le yìdiǎndiǎn. Nǐ zuìjìn cháng áoyè ma?
them.en: That one's sleep-related, slightly elevated. Been staying up late?

turns.task: Confess — work has been busy, sleeping around 1 AM lately.

ans.zh: 最近工作比較忙，常常一點才睡。
ans.py: Zuìjìn gōngzuò bǐjiào máng, chángcháng yì diǎn cái shuì.
ans.en: Work's been busy — I've often been up till one.

them.zh: 了解。先不用吃藥，我們追蹤就好：十二點前睡，三個月後復診。
them.py: Liǎojiě. Xiān búyòng chī yào, wǒmen zhuīzōng jiù hǎo: shí'èr diǎn qián shuì, sān ge yuè hòu fùzhěn.
them.en: Understood. No medication yet — we'll just monitor: sleep before midnight, follow-up in three months.

turns.task: Agree — ask if the follow-up needs fasting too.

ans.zh: 好，我調整作息。請問復診也要空腹嗎？
ans.py: Hǎo, wǒ tiáozhěng zuòxí. Qǐngwèn fùzhěn yě yào kōngfù ma?
ans.en: Will do — I'll fix my schedule. Does the follow-up also require fasting?

them.zh: 要，一樣八小時。放心，這種情況追蹤之後大多會恢復正常。
them.py: Yào, yíyàng bā xiǎoshí. Fàngxīn, zhè zhǒng qíngkuàng zhuīzōng zhīhòu dàduō huì huīfù zhèngcháng.
them.en: Yes, same eight hours. Don't worry — with monitoring these usually return to normal.

turns.task: Joke that you just read the 諱疾忌醫 story — you won't be that king.

ans.zh: 我最近剛好讀了諱疾忌醫的故事，我不要當那個國王！
ans.py: Wǒ zuìjìn gānghǎo dú le huì jí jì yī de gùshì, wǒ bú yào dāng nàge guówáng!
ans.en: Funny — I just read the 'hide the illness, dodge the doctor' story. I refuse to be that king!

them.zh: 哈哈！懂成語的病人最讓醫生放心！三個月後見！
them.py: Hāhā! Dǒng chéngyǔ de bìngrén zuì ràng yīshēng fàngxīn! Sān ge yuè hòu jiàn!
them.en: Haha! Patients who know their chengyu are a doctor's favorite! See you in three months!

turns.task: Thank the doctor — see you in three months, well-rested.

ans.zh: 謝謝醫生！三個月後見，到時候我一定睡得很好！
ans.py: Xièxiè yīshēng! Sān ge yuè hòu jiàn, dào shíhòu wǒ yídìng shuì de hěn hǎo!
ans.en: Thank you, doctor! See you in three months — well-rested, I promise!

scenarios.intro: Xiaomei administers the benefits and knows every subsidy by heart. Extract maximum value.

them.zh: 健檢還順利嗎？費用不用擔心，全部由公司負擔！
them.py: Jiànjiǎn hái shùnlì ma? Fèiyòng búyòng dānxīn, quánbù yóu gōngsī fùdān!
them.en: How was the check? Don't worry about cost — the company covers it all!

turns.task: Smooth — and ask when the reports arrive.

ans.zh: 很順利！請問報告什麼時候會到？
ans.py: Hěn shùnlì! Qǐngwèn bàogào shénme shíhòu huì dào?
ans.en: Very smooth! When do the reports arrive?

them.zh: 兩週後寄到公司，由我統一發。對了，保險也升級了喔！
them.py: Liǎng zhōu hòu jì dào gōngsī, yóu wǒ tǒngyī fā. Duìle, bǎoxiǎn yě shēngjí le ō!
them.en: Two weeks — mailed here, I distribute them. Oh, and the insurance upgraded!

turns.task: Ask what the upgrade includes.

ans.zh: 太好了！保險升級之後多了什麼？
ans.py: Tài hǎo le! Bǎoxiǎn shēngjí zhīhòu duō le shénme?
ans.en: Nice! What does the upgraded insurance add?

them.zh: 住院補助提高到每天兩千，看牙齒一年最多補助三千！
them.py: Zhùyuàn bǔzhù tígāo dào měi tiān liǎngqiān, kàn yáchǐ yì nián zuìduō bǔzhù sānqiān!
them.en: Hospitalization subsidy up to two thousand a day, and dental up to three thousand a year!

turns.task: Dental too?! Ask how to claim it.

ans.zh: 連看牙齒都有補助？！要怎麼申請？
ans.py: Lián kàn yáchǐ dōu yǒu bǔzhù?! Yào zěnme shēnqǐng?
ans.en: Even dental is subsidized?! How do I claim it?

them.zh: 收據留下來，填一張單子給我就好，月底一起下來。
them.py: Shōujù liú xiàlái, tián yì zhāng dānzi gěi wǒ jiù hǎo, yuèdǐ yìqǐ xiàlái.
them.en: Keep the receipts, fill one form for me — it pays out at month's end.

turns.task: Easy — praise the company's benefits; health really is capital.

ans.zh: 很簡單耶！公司的福利真好，身體就是本錢！
ans.py: Hěn jiǎndān yē! Gōngsī de fúlì zhēn hǎo, shēntǐ jiùshì běnqián!
ans.en: So easy! Great benefits — health really is capital!

them.zh: 沒錯！下週就要去高雄了，大家健健康康最重要！
them.py: Méicuò! Xià zhōu jiù yào qù Gāoxióng le, dàjiā jiànjiànkāngkāng zuì zhòngyào!
them.en: Exactly! Kaohsiung is next week — everyone healthy is what matters most!

turns.task: Agree — healthy team, smooth signing!

ans.zh: 對！健康的團隊，簽約才會順利！
ans.py: Duì! Jiànkāng de tuánduì, qiānyuē cái huì shùnlì!
ans.en: Right! A healthy team makes for a smooth signing!

scenarios.intro: Mr. Wang saw the medical-drone trial results and his business brain is sparking. One week before the signing, a new market appears.

them.zh: 你看到新聞了嗎？離島的醫療配送試驗，成功率九成八！
them.py: Nǐ kàndào xīnwén le ma? Lídǎo de yīliáo pèisòng shìyàn, chénggōnglǜ jiǔ chéng bā!
them.en: Did you see the news? The offshore medical-delivery trial — ninety-eight percent success!

turns.task: You saw — average delivery under thirty minutes, several times faster than boats.

ans.zh: 看到了！平均三十分鐘內送達，比船運快好幾倍。
ans.py: Kàndào le! Píngjūn sānshí fēnzhōng nèi sòngdá, bǐ chuán yùn kuài hǎo jǐ bèi.
ans.en: I did! Average delivery under thirty minutes — several times faster than boat transport.

them.zh: 明年要擴大到山區部落。你覺得我們的平台適合這個市場嗎？
them.py: Míngnián yào kuòdà dào shānqū bùluò. Nǐ juéde wǒmen de píngtái shìhé zhège shìchǎng ma?
them.en: Next year it expands to mountain villages. Think our platform fits this market?

turns.task: Yes — your endurance and wind stability are exactly what medical delivery demands.

ans.zh: 很適合。醫療配送最需要的就是續航跟抗風的穩定，正好是我們的強項。
ans.py: Hěn shìhé. Yīliáo pèisòng zuì xūyào de jiùshì xùháng gēn kàngfēng de wěndìng, zhènghǎo shì wǒmen de qiángxiàng.
ans.en: Very much — medical delivery demands endurance and wind stability, exactly our strengths.

them.zh: 而且政府在推預防醫學，偏遠地區的需求只會越來越大。
them.py: Érqiě zhèngfǔ zài tuī yùfáng yīxué, piānyuǎn dìqū de xūqiú zhǐ huì yuè lái yuè dà.
them.en: And the government's pushing preventive medicine — remote-area demand will only grow.

turns.task: Agree — through tech delivery, medical quality won't be limited by distance anymore; the market has room.

ans.zh: 沒錯，透過科技配送，醫療品質不再受距離限制，這個市場的空間很大。
ans.py: Méicuò, tòuguò kējì pèisòng, yīliáo pǐnzhí bú zài shòu jùlí xiànzhì, zhège shìchǎng de kōngjiān hěn dà.
ans.en: Exactly — with tech-enabled delivery, care stops being distance-limited. This market has real room.

them.zh: 那簽約的時候，我們把醫療配送列入未來合作的方向？
them.py: Nà qiānyuē de shíhòu, wǒmen bǎ yīliáo pèisòng lièrù wèilái hézuò de fāngxiàng?
them.en: Then at the signing — shall we list medical delivery as a future cooperation direction?

turns.task: Support it — add it to the MOU's future scope; discuss details at the expo with real cases.

ans.zh: 我贊成，先寫進備忘錄的未來範圍，十月展覽的時候再帶著實際案例談細節。
ans.py: Wǒ zànchéng, xiān xiě jìn bèiwànglù de wèilái fànwéi, shí yuè zhǎnlǎn de shíhòu zài dàizhe shíjì ànlì tán xìjié.
ans.en: Agreed — write it into the MOU's future scope, then talk details at the October expo with real cases.

them.zh: 太好了！救災、巡邏、醫療——我們的合作越來越有意思了！
them.py: Tài hǎo le! Jiùzāi, xúnluó, yīliáo — wǒmen de hézuò yuè lái yuè yǒu yìsi le!
them.en: Excellent! Disaster relief, patrol, medical — our partnership keeps getting more interesting!

turns.task: Close warm — technology that saves lives is the best kind of business; see him next week.

ans.zh: 能救人的科技，就是最好的生意。下週高雄見！
ans.py: Néng jiù rén de kējì, jiùshì zuì hǎo de shēngyì. Xià zhōu Gāoxióng jiàn!
ans.en: Technology that saves lives is the best kind of business. See you in Kaohsiung next week!

x: 我的耳朵有一點痛。
Wǒ de ěrduo yǒu yìdiǎn tòng.
My ear hurts a little.
vocab.n: 朵 is also the measure word for flowers — 一朵花, 兩隻耳朵. 耳機 earphones grew from here.

x: 鼻子不舒服，可能感冒了。
Bízi bù shūfú, kěnéng gǎnmào le.
Nose feels off — maybe a cold.
vocab.n: 鼻水 runny nose, 鼻塞 stuffed nose — the cold-season duo. 鼻子很靈 = a sharp sense of smell.

x: 脖子痛，不要一直看手機。
Bózi tòng, búyào yìzhí kàn shǒujī.
Neck hurts? Stop staring at your phone.
vocab.n: 落枕 lào zhěn = the stiff neck from sleeping wrong. 烏龜脖 turtle neck — the modern phone-posture diagnosis.

x: 請先量身高跟體重。
Qǐng xiān liáng shēngāo gēn tǐzhòng.
Height and weight first, please.
vocab.n: 身 body + 高 tall. Asked as 你多高？ Answered in 公分: 一百七十八公分 — Taiwan is fully metric.

x: 我的體重是七十二公斤。
Wǒ de tǐzhòng shì qīshí'èr gōngjīn.
My weight is seventy-two kilograms.
vocab.n: 體 body + 重 weight, in 公斤 kilograms. 體重計 the scale — braver souls step on daily.

x: 現在幫您量血壓。
Xiànzài bāng nín liáng xiěyā.
Now I'll take your blood pressure.
vocab.n: 量身高/量體重/量體溫/量血壓 — the clinic's verb. Watch the tone: liáng to measure, liàng quantity (數量).

x: 下一站是抽血。
Xià yí zhàn shì chōuxiě.
Next station: the blood draw.
vocab.n: 抽 draw out + 血 blood. 血 reads xiě in speech, xuè in formal compounds. Same 抽 as 抽屜 drawer — things being pulled out.

x: 護理師人很溫柔。
Hùlǐshī rén hěn wēnróu.
The nurse is very gentle.
vocab.n: Taiwan's respectful standard term — 護士 is the older word, 護理師 the licensed title. Address them as 護理師 and earn instant goodwill.

x: 抽血前要空腹八小時。
Chōuxiě qián yào kōngfù bā xiǎoshí.
Fast eight hours before the blood draw.
vocab.n: 空 empty + 腹 belly. 空腹八小時 the standard order; 空腹血糖 fasting blood sugar. Opposite: 飯後 after meals.

x: 血壓很標準，不用擔心。
Xiěyā hěn biāozhǔn, búyòng dānxīn.
Blood pressure's normal — no worries.
vocab.n: 高血壓 hypertension, 量血壓 take a reading. Free machines sit in most Taiwan pharmacies — national pastime for grandparents.

x: 報告的數值大部分都正常。
Bàogào de shùzhí dàbùfèn dōu zhèngcháng.
Most of the report's values are normal.
vocab.n: 數 number + 值 value: lab results, sensor readings, test data. Doctors and engineers share this word — 數值正常 is what both want to say.

x: 三個月後要復診。
Sān ge yuè hòu yào fùzhěn.
Follow-up visit in three months.
vocab.n: 復 again + 診 consult — same 復 family as 復工/復甦. 回診 is the everyday synonym you'll hear at clinics.

x: 先追蹤，不用吃藥。
Xiān zhuīzōng, búyòng chī yào.
We'll monitor first — no medication.
vocab.n: 追 chase + 蹤 trail: doctors 追蹤 conditions, packages get 追蹤 numbers, and social media 追蹤 = follow. One word, three lives.

x: 公司每年安排一次健檢。
Gōngsī měi nián ānpái yí cì jiànjiǎn.
The company arranges a yearly health check.
vocab.n: 健康檢查 compressed — Taiwan loves two-character clips (健檢, 體檢). 健檢中心 checkup centers are their own industry here.

x: 健檢是公司的福利之一。
Jiànjiǎn shì gōngsī de fúlì zhī yī.
The health check is one of the company benefits.
vocab.n: 員工福利 employee benefits, 福利好 the recruiting magnet. Government scale: 社會福利 social welfare. 福利社 = the beloved school snack co-op.

x: 公司的團體保險升級了。
Gōngsī de tuántǐ bǎoxiǎn shēngjí le.
The company's group insurance upgraded.
vocab.n: 保 protect + 險 risk. 保險公司 insurer, 買保險 buy coverage. Doubles as an adjective: 比較保險 = the safer bet.

x: 無人機正快速進入醫療領域。
Wúrénjī zhèng kuàisù jìnrù yīliáo lǐngyù.
Drones are rapidly entering the medical field.
vocab.n: 醫 medicine + 療 treatment: 醫療品質 care quality, 醫療團隊 medical team, 醫療科技 medtech. The sector word above 看醫生's street level.

x: 預防勝於治療。
Yùfáng shèng yú zhìliáo.
Prevention beats cure.
vocab.n: 預 in advance + 防 guard — same 防 as 防颱/防災. 預防醫學 preventive medicine, 預防針 vaccination. The proverb in the example is universal.

x: 離島的交通常受天氣影響。
Lídǎo de jiāotōng cháng shòu tiānqì yǐngxiǎng.
Offshore-island transport is often weather-affected.
vocab.n: 離 apart + 島 island: Penghu, Kinmen, Matsu, Green Island. 離島補助 island subsidies, 離島醫療 island healthcare — a permanent policy topic.

x: 透過無人機配送，三十分鐘內送達。
Tòuguò wúrénjī pèisòng, sānshí fēnzhōng nèi sòngdá.
Via drone delivery, arrival within thirty minutes.
vocab.n: 配 allocate + 送 deliver: the logistics-system word, bigger than 外送 (food delivery). 配送中心 distribution center, 低溫配送 cold chain.

slang.e: red numbers — flagged results on a health report
x: 今年的健檢只有一個紅字，還不錯啦！
Jīnnián de jiànjiǎn zhǐyǒu yí ge hóngzì, hái búcuò la!
Only one red number on this year's checkup — not bad!
slang.n: Abnormal values print in red, so 有沒有紅字？ is how coworkers ask about each other's checkups. Zero 紅字 = bragging rights.

x: 他什麼都敢吃，從來不會拉肚子，根本鐵胃。
Tā shénme dōu gǎn chī, cónglái bú huì lādùzi, gēnběn tiěwèi.
He'll eat anything and never gets sick — total iron stomach.
slang.n: 鐵 iron + 胃 stomach: the friend who survives every questionable night-market stall. A superpower, until the 健檢 says otherwise.

x: 醫生說少喝肥宅快樂水，我心好痛。
Yīshēng shuō shǎo hē féizhái kuàilè shuǐ, wǒ xīn hǎo tòng.
The doctor said cut back on the happy water — my heart aches.
slang.n: 肥宅 (chubby homebody) + 快樂水 (happiness water) = cola, the internet's self-aware pet name for it. Affectionate, not cruel — usually self-applied.

slang.e: the will to survive — quick self-correction instinct
x: 老婆問我她變胖沒，我馬上說沒有——求生欲很強。
Lǎopó wèn wǒ tā biàn pàng méi, wǒ mǎshàng shuō méiyǒu — qiúshēngyù hěn qiáng.
My wife asked if she'd gained weight; I instantly said no — strong survival instinct.
slang.n: 求生 survival + 欲 desire: answering dangerous questions correctly at speed. 求生欲很強 = high praise for relationship reflexes.

x: 空腹等抽血的大家，每個都是厭世臉。
Kōngfù děng chōuxiě de dàjiā, měi ge dōu shì yànshì liǎn.
Everyone fasting in the blood-draw line wears the same world-weary face.
slang.n: 厭世 sick-of-the-world + 臉 face: the default expression of Monday commutes and waiting rooms. Some people are just born with it — 天生厭世臉.
